content: The Executor successfully automated the HWPX template filling process by treating the HWPX as a ZIP archive and manipulating the internal XML. Key success factors included: 1) Normalizing fragmented `<hp:t>` tags within `<hp:run>` elements to ensure `{{placeholder}}` strings were contiguous before replacement. 2) Stripping `<hp:lineSegArray>` elements to force the HWP editor to recalculate the layout, preventing text overlap. 3) Correctly handling the `mimetype` file (uncompressed, first in archive) to maintain HWPX format integrity.
